why: A request whose Host is not this office's (wave 13s, line 13s, SEC-1). It is refused before any other hook, and only when a listener carried the request: this test reaches every door by inject, which no listener carries, so no door here can meet it. tests/a-request-that-names-another-host-is-refused.test.ts meets it through each of the three listeners, in cases 1, 2 and 4 to 11.

refusals.english: Test: this office does not answer to the name this request used.
